id: title:gantoine:take desktop tests off the master push lane

review.posthog_relevance: Changes are strictly to PostHog's internal CI configuration and build workflows; no PostHog product, user-facing, or operational reliability benefit is demonstrated.
review.reason: The observed changes modify GitHub Actions workflow files to change the trigger conditions for desktop builds and tests. While this may improve the efficiency of PostHog's own development and release pipeline by reducing unnecessary execution and queue contention, it does not demonstrate a benefit to PostHog's customers, the PostHog application, or PostHog's production reliability.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the narrow, maintenance-like nature of the change. No tier 2 or 3 is assigned because the implementation does not demonstrate a substantive, bounded capability or systemic risk reduction for PostHog's end-users or production stability.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains five hunks across four workflow files. P1.F3.H2 and P1.F3.H1 both modify the same conditional and share identical trunk-merge exemption comments, suggesting a single coordinated change rather than unrelated PRs. observations.behavior: Adds explicit ready_for_review trigger and draft PR exclusion to desktop-build.yml, while retaining trunk-merge exemption.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop CI now runs bundler checks on ready_for_review instead of every push, avoiding unnecessary depot-ubuntu-40.04-4 usage and preventing queue starvation while still gating master. This also prevents the expensive bundler check from running on draft PRs, which do not require the bundled desktop app.

observations.behavior: Adds ready_for_review trigger and draft PR exclusion to desktop-test.yml, while retaining trunk-merge exemption.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop E2E now runs on ready_for_review instead of every push, avoiding unnecessary depot-macos-26 usage and preventing queue starvation while still gating master. This also prevents the expensive E2E check from running on draft PRs, which do not require the bundled desktop app.

observations.behavior: Adds ready_for_review trigger and draft PR exclusion to desktop-ci.yml, while retaining trunk-merge exemption.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop CI now dispatches on ready_for_review, enabling the parent workflow to trigger its children without requiring a push. This supports the new ready_for_review-based gating while retaining trunk-merge exemption.
